content: Mǝtalabangŋo twal Bezal-El andǝ Oholiyapace túró pàk Taragula
Yahweh bangcau nǝ Musa ama,
<<Sǝni, ǝn twalna Bezal-El muna-ɓwabura mala Uri, mǝkà Hur, a tàu mala Yahuda sǝ
ǝn lúmsǝ̀nì nǝ bangŋo mala Ɓakuli.
Ən panì wi kwárô aɓa ɗenyicau, andǝ súrǝ̀gir, andǝ sǝlǝe mala pàk koya ulang túróbù;
nǝ̀ sǝlǝ nyoulǝ pǎ mala agir mǝɓoarsǝne ɗàng-ɗáng, andǝ tùlki agir nǝ bolo-njengǝlan, bolo-azǝrfa, andǝ bolo-bángŋá;
ndanǝ sǝlǝpe mala kpaliki rǝ atali-gǝna ace oasǝkia aɓalǝ agir-bwalia, andǝ mala shàr nggun, andǝ mala pak koya ulang túróbù.

Ɗǝm ngga ǝn twalna Oholiyap, muna-ɓwabura mala Ahisamak, a tàu mala Dan, ɓǝà pàktúró andǝi. Nyare ǝn panì acili aɓwana mǝnana kat amǝ pàkkiagir túróbù na ka sǝlǝpe ace mǝnana ɓǝà pàk koya gìr kat gǝ̀rgǝ̀r kǝla mǝnana ǝn banggo nǝma ɓǝà pè ka amur cau mala:
Tara Ban-peri, andǝ Akwati mala Acau-nakûn andǝ gìrkúni amurí, mǝnana nda buno sǝntǝ̀r ka, andǝ acili agir mana kat à nǝ̀ tsǝia aɓa Tara Ban-peri ka,
andǝ kpamgbang-tsǝk-agir andǝ agirtúró male amurí, andǝ gìr tamsǝ apitǝla, andǝ agirtúró male kat, andǝ gyangŋan ace loasǝ yele mǝ'rǝmɓoarne,
andǝ gyangŋan mala pagir mala pisǝ kǝring andǝ agirtúró male kat, andǝ nkenye andǝ girtàmsǝe,
andǝ adaura-pǝris amǝ'ɓoarɓwe, yi adaura mǝfele ace Haruna pǝris mǝgule andǝ adaura ace amuna-burana male, mǝnana à nǝ̀ oasǝ arǝia ɓǝ̀ à nǝ̀ pàk túró pǝris ka,
andǝ mùrú-ɗārǝ́bân, andǝ muku-agir loasǝ yele mǝ'rǝmɓoarne ace Ban Mǝfele. Aɓa pàkki amǝnia yì agir kat ka, ɓǝà peǎ gǝ̀rgǝ̀r kǝla mǝnana ǝn banggo ka.>>
Nggurcau amur Pwari Sabbat
Pǝlǝa Yahweh bangcau nǝ Musa ama,

<<Ne amǝ Isǝrayila ama, <Dumǝna wun púp wun nǝ̀ kpata nzongcau mala Pwari Sabbat, pwari usǝlǝo mem. Acemǝnana Pwari Sabbat ka nda gìr'lǝmdǝa a nrem sǝnǝa wun aban ká arǝ anza mǝnana kat à kǝ yiu ka, ace mǝnana ɓǝ̀ wu sǝlǝ ama, Mim Yahweh ka, ǝn tárnà wun ɓǝ̀ wu duk aɓwana mem.

Dumǝna púp wun nǝ̀ kpata nzongcau mala Pwari Sabbat, acemǝnana pwari mǝfele na aban wun. Ɓwa mǝnana pǝndǝkice ka, dumǝna púp à nǝ̀ wali ɓǝ̀ wú. Ɓwa mǝnana pàk túró a pwari mǝno ka, à nǝ̀ pusǝì, pà nǝ̀ pa aɓalǝ aɓwana male ɗàng.

Wu ndanǝ anongŋo tongno-nong-mwashat mala pàkki atúró, sǝama tongno-nong-ɓaria pwari ka, nda pwari Sabbat mala usǝlǝo, pwari mǝfele mana à tàrì ace Yahweh ka. Ɓwa mǝnana bwal túró a Pwari Sabbat ka, dumǝna púp à nǝ̀ wali ɓǝ̀ wú.
Acemani ka, amǝ Isǝrayila nǝ̀ pà gulo arǝ Pwari Sabbat, à nǝ̀ kpata nzongcau male arǝ anza mǝnana kat à kǝ yiu ka, kǝla kùrcau mana málá male pà kàm raka.

Mǝnia yì pwari ka, nǝ̀ do gìr'lǝmdǝa na tàtǝ́k a nrem sǝnǝ amǝ Isǝrayila ama, Mim Yahweh ka, ǝn pusǝ kùli andǝ nzali aɓa nongŋo tongno-nong-mwashat, sǝ a tongno-nong-ɓaria pwari ka, ǝn nying buam arǝ túró, ǝn usǝlǝo.
Lang Ɓakuli malna nacau nǝ Musa amur Nkono Saina ka, pǝlǝa pè wi akpamgbǝlang tali ɓari mala Acau-nakûn, yì akpamgbǝlang Acau-nakûn mǝnana Ɓakuli nyoulǝia nǝ munabui ka.

footnotes.text: bangŋo mala Ɓakuli ko bangŋo mem.
ǝn nying buam arǝ túró, ǝn usǝlǝo ko <<ǝn usǝlǝo, ǝn tusǝɓalǝam.>>
